summary: Deployed a 4-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1-node4) on RHEL 9.8. Bootstrapped node1, joined node2 and node3 via rsync SST to form the initial 3-node cluster with an application database (appdb.orders), then added node4 by updating all nodes' gcomm address lists and starting it - node4 received the full existing dataset via SST and successfully accepted a new write that replicated to all other members. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all 4 nodes (node2, node3, node4, node1 in that order), each restart preserving quorum with the other 3 members, verified via changed OS boot_id and full Galera re-sync (wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced state, data intact) after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, mariadb-server-utils, galera, rsync on all 4 nodes
Opened firewalld ports 3306/4444/4567(tcp+udp)/4568 on all 4 nodes; confirmed SELinux mysqld_port_t already covers these ports
Generated SST auth password and root password on node1 via openssl rand, passed only via secret_env
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on node1-node3 with wsrep_on=1, cluster_name, 3-node gcomm cluster_address, node_address/name, sst_auth
Bootstrapped node1 with galera_new_cluster, set root password, verified Primary/Synced/size=1
Started mariadb on node2 and node3, confirmed rsync SST joins, cluster_size reached 3
Created appdb.orders application table on node1 with sample rows; verified replication to node2/node3 and multi-master write from node3
Wrote node4 galera.cnf with 4-node gcomm address list; updated node1-node3 configs to include node4
Started mariadb on node4; confirmed rsync SST transferred mysql and appdb databases; verified cluster_size=4, Synced, existing data present
Wrote a new row from node4 and confirmed it replicated back to node1
Enabled mariadb systemd unit on all 4 nodes for boot persistence
Captured baseline boot_id, wsrep status, and row count on all 4 nodes

Restarted node2, node3, node4, node1 sequentially (systemctl reboot backgrounded so ack returns before disconnect), polled each until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified mariadb active + wsrep Synced + cluster_size=4 + data intact after each restart, always with 3 other nodes up

evidence.requirement: 3-node Galera cluster on node1-node3 with application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped (size=1), node2 and node3 joined via SST reaching size=3/Primary, appdb.orders created and data confirmed present on node2, multi-master write from node3 confirmed

evidence.requirement: node4 added as 4th member carrying existing data
evidence.summary: node4 galera.cnf configured with 4-node gcomm list; mariadb start triggered SST transferring mysql and appdb DBs from node1; node4 shows cluster_size=4, Synced, and pre-existing 4 rows

evidence.requirement: node4 accepts writes like other members
evidence.summary: Inserted a row directly on node4 (count 4->5) and confirmed the same row is visible and replicated on node1
